description: This Java source file defines the MakeFileParser class, which parses make files to extract key-value pairs and handle variable substitutions, primarily used for processing Android build make files.

classes.name: MakeFileParser
classes.description: A class that parses make files to extract key-value pairs, handle variable substitutions, and identify modules within Android build files.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns an iterable of values associated with a given key from the make file.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Reads and processes the make file to extract key-value pairs.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the parser's current state, including parsed values.
